from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

# TASK
task_text = "Approve all venmo payment requests from my roommates from this calendar month."
print('Task:', task_text)

# Compute current calendar month boundaries
now = datetime.now()
month_start = datetime(year=now.year, month=now.month, day=1)
# first day of next month
if now.month == 12:
    next_month_start = datetime(year=now.year+1, month=1, day=1)
else:
    next_month_start = datetime(year=now.year, month=now.month+1, day=1)
print('now:', now.isoformat())
print('month_start:', month_start.isoformat())
print('next_month_start:', next_month_start.isoformat())

# Phone login
phone_pw = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]['password']
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='9503658964', password=phone_pw)['access_token']

# Fetch roommate contacts (paginated)
all_roommates = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', relationship='roommate', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_roommates.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('Roommate phone contacts:', len(all_roommates))
roommate_contacts = []
for c in all_roommates:
    roommate_contacts.append({
        'contact_id': c.get('contact_id'),
        'first_name': c.get('first_name'),
        'last_name': c.get('last_name'),
        'email': c.get('email'),
        'phone_number': c.get('phone_number')
    })
print('Roommate contacts:', roommate_contacts)

# Criteria table
criteria = [
    ('Identity', 'roommates (phone contacts)', 'phone.search_contacts(..., relationship="roommate") mapped to venmo users'),
    ('Direction', 'payment requests you received (to you)', 'venmo.show_received_payment_requests'),
    ('Time', 'this calendar month', 'payment_request.created_at in [month_start, next_month_start)'),
    ('Status', 'approve payment requests', 'venmo.show_received_payment_requests status="pending"')
]
print('CRITERIA TABLE:')
for row in criteria:
    print(row[0], '|', row[1], '|', row[2])
print('Criteria count:', len(criteria))

# Venmo login
venmo_pw = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
venmo_username = 'nicholas.weber@gmail.com'
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username=venmo_username, password=venmo_pw)['access_token']
print('venmo access_token prefix:', venmo_token[:12])

# Map roommate contacts to Venmo users (by email first, then by exact name)
venmo_mapped_emails = set()
venmo_user_records = []

# helper: pagination loop for search_users

def search_venmo_users(query):
    res_all = []
    pi = 0
    pl = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=query, page_index=pi, page_limit=pl)
        if not page:
            break
        res_all.extend(page)
        pi += 1
    return res_all

for rc in roommate_contacts:
    email = (rc.get('email') or '').strip()
    first = (rc.get('first_name') or '').strip()
    last = (rc.get('last_name') or '').strip()
    candidates = []

    if email:
        candidates = search_venmo_users(email)
        # exact-match post-filter on email
        email_lower = email.lower()
        exact = [u for u in candidates if (u.get('email') or '').lower() == email_lower]
        print('Venmo search by email for', first, last, 'email', email, '-> total', len(candidates), 'exact_email', len(exact))
        if len(exact) == 1:
            venmo_mapped_emails.add(exact[0].get('email'))
            venmo_user_records.append({'contact': first+' '+last, 'resolved_email': exact[0].get('email')})
            continue
        elif len(exact) > 1:
            print('AMBIGUITY: multiple Venmo users with exact email', email, 'excluding')

    # fallback by exact name
    if first and last:
        name_query = f"{first} {last}"
        candidates = search_venmo_users(name_query)
        exact = [u for u in candidates if u.get('first_name','').lower()==first.lower() and u.get('last_name','').lower()==last.lower()]
        print('Venmo search by name for', name_query, '-> total', len(candidates), 'exact_name', len(exact))
        if len(exact) == 1:
            venmo_mapped_emails.add(exact[0].get('email'))
            venmo_user_records.append({'contact': first+' '+last, 'resolved_email': exact[0].get('email')})
        elif len(exact) > 1:
            print('AMBIGUITY: multiple Venmo users with exact name', name_query, 'excluding')

print('Identity resolution results:')
print('Phone roommate contacts resolved:', len(roommate_contacts))
print('Mapped Venmo sender emails:', len(venmo_mapped_emails), sorted(list(venmo_mapped_emails)))
print('Mapped records:', venmo_user_records)

# Fetch all pending received payment requests (paginated)
payment_requests = []
pi = 0
pl = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, status='pending', page_index=pi, page_limit=pl)
    if not page:
        break
    payment_requests.extend(page)
    pi += 1
print('Total pending received payment requests:', len(payment_requests))

# Parse created_at and filter by month + roommate sender

def parse_iso(dt_str):
    # handle trailing Z if present
    if not dt_str:
        return None
    s = dt_str
    s = s.replace('Z','')
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(s)
    except Exception:
        # try common format
        return datetime.strptime(s.split('.')[0], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')

month_filtered = []
for pr in payment_requests:
    created = parse_iso(pr.get('created_at'))
    if not created:
        continue
    if not (month_start <= created < next_month_start):
        continue
    sender_email = (pr.get('sender') or {}).get('email','').lower()
    if sender_email and sender_email in {e.lower() for e in venmo_mapped_emails}:
        month_filtered.append(pr)

print('After month + roommate filter:', len(month_filtered))

# Print verification table

def fmt_pr(pr):
    sid = pr.get('payment_request_id')
    amt = pr.get('amount')
    desc = pr.get('description')
    created = pr.get('created_at')
    sender = pr.get('sender') or {}
    return (sid, amt, desc, created, sender.get('email'), sender.get('name'))

for row in [fmt_pr(pr) for pr in month_filtered]:
    print('payment_request_id | amount | description | created_at | sender_email | sender_name')
    print(row)

# Build target set
payment_request_ids = [pr.get('payment_request_id') for pr in month_filtered]
print('TARGET payment_request_ids:', payment_request_ids)
print('TARGET count:', len(payment_request_ids))

# Store for next step
TARGET_PAYMENT_REQUEST_IDS = payment_request_ids

from datetime import datetime

# Re-load targets from prior steps if present
print('Task asks:', 'Approve all venmo payment requests from my roommates from this calendar month.')

# Criteria enumeration gate (explicit)
criteria = [
    ('Roommates', 'my roommates', 'phone.search_contacts(..., relationship="roommate") mapped to Venmo users by exact email'),
    ('This calendar month', 'from this calendar month', 'payment_request.created_at between month_start (inclusive) and next_month_start (exclusive)'),
    ('Payment requests received by me', 'venmo payment requests from', 'venmo.show_received_payment_requests (direction: received by me)'),
    ('Approval action', 'Approve all', 'venmo.approve_payment_request for payment_request_id')
]
print('CRITERIA TABLE:')
for c in criteria:
    print(c[0], '|', c[1], '|', c[2])

# Ensure we have month_start/next_month_start and action IDs
print('month_start:', month_start.isoformat())
print('next_month_start:', next_month_start.isoformat())

# Compose action payload and verification table
TARGET_PAYMENT_REQUEST_IDS = TARGET_PAYMENT_REQUEST_IDS  # from prior
ACTION_PAYMENT_REQUEST_IDS = ACTION_PAYMENT_REQUEST_IDS  # from prior
print('Computed ACTION_PAYMENT_REQUEST_IDS:', ACTION_PAYMENT_REQUEST_IDS)
print('Count:', len(ACTION_PAYMENT_REQUEST_IDS))

# Fetch those specific requests (from cached by_id if possible) by refetching all received to verify details
# We'll refetch all received (all statuses) to guarantee fields exist.

# login tokens (should exist)
print('venmo_token prefix:', venmo_token[:12])

# Fetch all received payment requests
all_received = []
pi = 0
pl = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=pi, page_limit=pl)
    if not page:
        break
    all_received.extend(page)
    pi += 1

by_id = {pr.get('payment_request_id'): pr for pr in all_received}

# Print verification table for each target before action
verification_rows = []
roommate_emails_lower = {e.lower() for e in venmo_mapped_emails}


def parse_iso(dt_str):
    if not dt_str:
        return None
    s = dt_str.replace('Z','')
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(s)
    except Exception:
        return datetime.strptime(s.split('.')[0], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')

for pid in ACTION_PAYMENT_REQUEST_IDS:
    pr = by_id.get(pid)
    created = parse_iso(pr.get('created_at')) if pr else None
    verification_rows.append({
        'payment_request_id': pid,
        'amount': pr.get('amount') if pr else None,
        'description': pr.get('description') if pr else None,
        'created_at': pr.get('created_at') if pr else None,
        'sender_name': (pr.get('sender') or {}).get('name') if pr else None,
        'sender_email': (pr.get('sender') or {}).get('email') if pr else None,
        'created_in_month': created is not None and (month_start <= created < next_month_start),
        'sender_is_roommate': ((pr.get('sender') or {}).get('email','') or '').lower() in roommate_emails_lower if pr else False,
        'status': pr.get('status') if pr else None
    })

print('VERIFICATION TABLE (pre-approve):')
for row in verification_rows:
    print(row)

# derive ids to approve as those still pending
pending_ids = []
for row in verification_rows:
    pr = by_id[row['payment_request_id']]
    status = pr.get('status')
    if status is None:
        # infer from approved_at/denied_at
        if pr.get('approved_at'):
            status = 'approved'
        elif pr.get('denied_at'):
            status = 'denied'
        else:
            status = 'pending'
    if status == 'pending':
        pending_ids.append(row['payment_request_id'])

print('Need approve (pending) ids:', pending_ids)
print('Need approve count:', len(pending_ids))

APPROVE_IDS = pending_ids

VENMO_TARGET_IDS = [6168, 6149, 6151, 6145, 6143, 6137, 6138, 6139, 6131]

# Re-login Venmo
venmo_pw = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

# Current month boundaries (for completeness)
now = datetime.now()
month_start = datetime(year=now.year, month=now.month, day=1)
if now.month == 12:
    next_month_start = datetime(year=now.year+1, month=1, day=1)
else:
    next_month_start = datetime(year=now.year, month=now.month+1, day=1)

# Fetch all received payment requests (all statuses)
all_received=[]
pi=0
pl=20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=pi, page_limit=pl)
    if not page:
        break
    all_received.extend(page)
    pi += 1
by_id = {pr.get('payment_request_id'): pr for pr in all_received}


def parse_iso(dt_str):
    if not dt_str:
        return None
    s = dt_str.replace('Z','')
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(s)
    except Exception:
        return datetime.strptime(s.split('.')[0], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')

verif = []
roommate_emails_lower = {'mel.bailey@gmail.com','an-harrison@gmail.com','anita.burch@gmail.com'}
for pid in VENMO_TARGET_IDS:
    pr = by_id.get(pid)
    status = None
    if pr:
        status = pr.get('status')
        if status is None:
            if pr.get('approved_at'):
                status = 'approved'
            elif pr.get('denied_at'):
                status = 'denied'
            else:
                status = 'pending'
    verif.append({
        'payment_request_id': pid,
        'exists': pr is not None,
        'status': status,
        'approved_at': pr.get('approved_at') if pr else None,
        'sender_email': ((pr.get('sender') or {}).get('email') if pr else None),
        'created_in_month': (parse_iso(pr.get('created_at'))>=month_start and parse_iso(pr.get('created_at'))<next_month_start) if pr else None
    })

print('Post-action verification:')
for row in verif:
    print(row)
